name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides' journey into motorsport finance was a calculated one. Armed with an MBA from IESE Business School, Ricardo initially worked in corporate finance before a chance meeting with a Formula 3 team owner at a Barcelona networking event sparked his interest. He was drawn to the high-stakes, fast-paced world of racing, seeing it as a challenge to apply his financial acumen in a dynamic environment. Ricardo believes in meticulous budgeting and rigorous cost control, ensuring every euro is accounted for and contributes to on-track performance.

Ricardo joined ART Grand Prix five years ago, quickly establishing himself as a pillar of financial stability. He's known for his relentless pursuit of efficiency and his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising the team's competitiveness. Ricardo's analytical approach and data-driven decision-making have been instrumental in securing sponsorships and optimizing resource allocation. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo, often questioning spending decisions and pushing for greater accountability.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to financial integrity and his belief that sound financial management is essential for long-term success. He approaches his work with a blend of pragmatism and passion, striving to create a financial framework that empowers the team to achieve its goals on and off the track.
